name.baseName: Raw cow milk, at farm, produced in Northern Italy

dataSetInformation.common:synonyms: Latte crudo vaccino, all’azienda agrozootecnica, prodotto in Nord Italia
dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Dataset developed within the ARCADIA Project (production chain study regarding raw cow milk “STUDIO DI FILIERA DEL LATTE CRUDO VACCINO DEL NORD ITALIA”), in compliance with the technical report “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA”. The dataset refers to the production of raw cow milk at farm, without further transformation and/or processing and is representative of the Northern Italy processing technologies commonly used for the production of raw cow milk.

referenceToExternalDocumentation.common:shortDescription: Fantin V., Cortesi S., Frisone F., Sandrucci A., Tamburini A., Bava L., Zucali M., Gislon G., 2023. “STUDIO DI FILIERA DEL LATTE CRUDO VACCINO DEL NORD ITALIA”. Internal report ARCADIA Project. For the LCA study background datasets from Ecoinvent database cut-off (v. 3.7.1) were used.

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: Northern Italy. Primary data collected in Lombardia. Dataset representative of Northern Italy production of raw cow milk.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse: The functional unit is 1 kg of raw cow milk, intermediate product, available for all subsequent processing operations and for its transformation in other products of the dairy supply chain (butter, cheese, drinking milk, yogurt, etc.). System boundaries are from cradle to farm gate and include the production of on-farm feed, animal breeding and milking phases. Production of equipment and infrastructures is not included, except for the background system. No final packaging is used. Primary data (Lombardy supply chain) representative of the Northern Italy supply chain for geographical characteristics and technologies used (machinery, equipment, etc.) were collected. Inventory data were collected as physical quantities of materials used in different processes. Background data were modelled according to Ecoinvent v. 3.7.1
technology.technologicalApplicability: Raw cow milk, intermediate product which can be used for further transformation or processing in the dairy sector to obtain dairy products (eg. butter, cheese, drinking milk, yogurt, etc.)

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.dataCutOffAndCompletenessPrinciples: Production of equipment and infrastructure are not included, except for the background system.

review.common:reviewDetails: The review was performed in compliance with Arcadia Metodology: “Metodologia per gli studi di filiera della Banca Dati italiana LCA” and ISO 14040-44 norms. The dataset has been assessed limited to the foreground data collected during the supply chain studies. The dataset has been evaluated based on the following 4 criteria: 1. Technological Representativeness; 2. Time Representativeness; 3. Geographical Representativeness; 4. Reliability. In this contest the Reliability is “good”.
review.common:otherReviewDetails: The study was judged by the reviewer as compliant with both ISO 14040-44 and Arcadia methodology

exchange.generalComment: Data were provided from Università degli Studi di Milano, Scienze Agrarie e Ambientali - Produzione, Territorio, Agroenergia They were collected during the LIFE DOP and LIFE Forage4Climate projects and refer to 2019. They refer to the production of 119,010,826 kg of raw cow milk produced by 98 cow farms located in Lombardy (Italy). Milk/meat allocation = 85%/15%
